name: How do I know if my windows have air leaks?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my windows have air leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of window air leaks include drafts near windows, higher energy bills, condensation between window panes, or rattling windows during windy conditions. You can perform a simple test by holding a lit incense stick or a tissue near the window frame on a breezy day; if the smoke wavers or the tissue moves, you likely have an air leak. Another method is the 'dollar bill test,' where you close a window on a dollar bill; if you can pull it out easily, there's a gap.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, higher energy bills, or condensation. You can also perform a simple incense stick or dollar bill test to detect leaks.
